subject: Only rebuild server when src or deps are modified (#12799)
reason: The change edits only src/mkreleasehdr.sh, narrowing the GIT_DIRTY check to `git diff -- src deps` so that modifications outside src/ and deps/ no longer mark the build dirty and force a rebuild. This is purely a build/CI convenience change: it does not alter any server behavior, command replies, replication, persistence, or tool output at runtime (at most the dirty-flag suffix in the version string of a locally dirty build). There is no runtime path for a fuzzer scenario to reach, so no scenario is needed.
